verificationLimits: Native Unity/C# execution, particles, audio and frame parity are not recovered. Literal native event clocks and original facing bindings are preserved, not a frame-perfect claim.

TileSelector filter12 executable body is not recovered. The native graph records SELF/CAST selection; the bounded local controller evaluates the furthest authored forward4-1 tile at projectile release. Operator relocation/facing changes during startup, edge-of-map and off-board destination parity remain unverified.

The projectile curve controller executable body is not recovered. The local controller evaluates the original Hermite curve at normalized projectile age and interpolates selected minimum/maximum ATK scales; timing versus distance under external projectile slowdown remains unverified in-game.

Native moving-collider overlap/dispatch ordering and enemy collider radii are not recovered. The local swept circle uses radius0.5 against shared point/huge-body geometry; each live enemy identity is hit once, ground and air, ignoring camouflage.
Native S1 mode restart phase timing is not recovered. The local adapter uses source Attack/Idle aliases immediately and restores ordinary clips at finish without inventing Begin/End delays.

Native ON_OUTPUT_DAMAGE ordering with source retirement, cancellation or simultaneous skill finish is not executable here. Selected talent DamageScale uses the local post-DEF damage multiplier while the source skill is active, with first-use and per-deployment state preserved.

previousDeferral.reason: S2 projectile preserves native min/max blackboard keys and exact scaleCurve, but no executable source binds its normalized argument to elapsed travel, distance, source position or endpoint. Inventing a distance interpolation would alter damage materially; this complete kit is deferred.

sourceInvestigations.curveBoundary: Native executable normalized input remains unrecovered. At source speed10, life0.4 and fixed4-tile travel, normalized distance and normalized age agree; the tested local mapping is normalized age. External speed/owner movement parity is not claimed.
